caption_F1.text: Figure F1 (experiments E1, E2, E4 and E5; v3 identifiers H2a, H2b and H3c). One panel per primary part, one row per system. Each marker is the stored estimate and each bar its moving-block bootstrap percentile interval (blocks of 5 consecutive test states, 2000 resamples) at level 98.33% (each panel states its level). The shaded region is the pass band of v3 §2. Marker shape and text give the stored verdict: filled circle pass, cross fail, open diamond inconclusive. A system that failed the validation gate is marked PROVISIONAL.

caption_F2.text: Figure F2 (experiments E2 to E5; v3 identifiers H1a to H1d, H2c to H2e, H3b and Q-N). One panel per secondary part, one row per system. Each marker is the stored estimate and each bar its moving-block bootstrap percentile interval (blocks of 5 consecutive test states, 2000 resamples; H3b resamples construction states) at the level stated in each panel (95% unless the result stores another). The shaded region is the pass band of v3 §2. For Q-N no band is shaded: dashed lines mark the reading edges of v3 §7. Each panel states its level, and the three H2c panels are drawn one per system because the scales differ. Marker shape and text give the stored verdict or reading: filled circle pass, cross fail, open diamond inconclusive, square a Q-N reading (both readings, the logit part and the indicator part) or a quantity that is reported with no verdict. A system that failed the validation gate is marked PROVISIONAL.

caption_F3.text: Figure F3 (cross-check, information only; v3 §9 item 3, DEC-0031; experiments E1, E2, E4 and E5). For each of the 18 primary parts, the away-arm z value comparing the official CPU run with the GPU run of the same seed, from the compare_runs text (interval procedure: the 98.33% moving-block bootstrap intervals of the two runs). The dashed line is the bound 3.4. A row would name a failed GPU validation gate and a PROVISIONAL official system if there were one; the footer states the GPU gate of each system. This figure changes no verdict.

coverage_limit.text: The block-5 percentile intervals undercover at these sample sizes: about 0.938 to 0.947 at 95% with independent states and 0.923 to 0.931 at lag-1 autocorrelation 0.3, which adds about 1 to 2 percentage points of false-verdict probability under dependence (v3 §8; DEF-0020). The pre-registered intervals and block length are kept.

lm_limitation.text: the iterative error of the fixed Levenberg–Marquardt budget of the PLP estimator (15 iterations) is not estimated for this run. On the development seed DEV-0, a study with 15, 30 and 60 iterations showed the iterative change below 10% of the sampling half-width for 5 of the 18 primary parts (class N) and did not show it below 10% for the other 13 (class X, not negligible, 6; class U, not certified, 7). The projection of its size against the half-width to the full preset, by the square root of the ratio of the numbers of test states, is stated and not applied. This is development evidence, not a result of this run.

wording.supported: Pass on all three systems in this preliminary, unpromoted run. The error of "supported" needs no further multiplicity correction (intersection–union).
wording.not supported: Fail on at least one system. The error of "not supported" is not controlled this way (§7), and this is not a statement about systems beyond the three studied.
wording.inconclusive: No system failed and at least one could not be decided at this precision. Inconclusive does not say the effect is absent.
wording.reading:H2a: Pre-registered reading of a failure (v3 §7): instability enters the weight through anisotropic seeds, and the size of the departure measures how far real attractors are from the separation assumption. v3 §7 pre-registered this reading and it is not tested here.
wording.reading:H2c: Pre-registered reading (v3 §7), to be applied by the reader from the reported A4o − A2 interval: if H2c fails but A4o beats A2, the theory is right and the deployable seed estimates limit it.
wording.gate_failure: GATE FAILURE: at least one system failed the validation gate (E0). Its results are PROVISIONAL, its verdicts are shown as computed, and the failure is referred to the owner (DEC-0027, DEC-0031). Nothing proceeds to promotion until the owner rules.
wording.gate_ok: Every system passed the validation gate, so no result carries the PROVISIONAL mark.
wording.gpu_bound_ok: No primary part exceeds the bound: failing parts {failing}, largest z (away) {max_away}, bound {bound}.
wording.gpu_bound_exceeded: At least one primary part exceeds the bound: failing parts {failing}, largest z (away) {max_away}, bound {bound}.
wording.gpu_diff_count: Verdict-type leaves that differ between the two runs: {differing}. The stored verdict words among them are in the tables above; the official words stand.
wording.gpu_gate_ok: The GPU validation gate passed on every system.
wording.gpu_gate_failed: The GPU validation gate did not pass on {systems}, or its result is not recorded there. This is reported only (DEC-0031).
wording.gpu_info_only: All of this is reported only and changes no verdict (DEC-0031).
wording.secondary_intro: Secondary rows (v3 §2; each is read at the level {level} with no multiplicity adjustment, v3 §7):
